name: xynolog-codegen-node
description: The Node generators, until codegen/'s OCaml generator replaces each (plans: codegen.md). Each group is a generate:<group> script and its generate:<group>:check.

scripts.generate:haskell:check: node schemas/generate-operation-reports-haskell.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-session-adapters-haskell.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-annotation-adapters-haskell.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-cache-persistence-haskell.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-state-adapters-haskell.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-testing-adapters-haskell.mjs --check

scripts.generate:ocaml:check: node ocaml/generate-identifiers.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-support.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-client-timing.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-enums.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-bus.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-selectors.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-shapes.mjs --check && node ocaml/generate-records.mjs --check && node schemas/generate-testing-adapters-haskell.mjs --ocaml --check
